purpose: Frozen structured-widget release scope. P0 widgets must ship (with full keyboard/focus/accessibility and lossless behavior) before WYSIWYG can become the product default; P1 widgets may ship later without blocking the default switch.

notes.evidenceClaimBoundary: A widget evidence claim must reference a widget id inside the P0/P1 lists above; claims for any other widget id are out of scope and rejected.
notes.p0Gate: Each P0 widget requires keyboard-only mount/focus/edit/commit/cancel/undo/reveal/exit, focus not trapped, accessible names, and exact source fallback on unsupported models.
notes.p1Policy: P1 widgets remain default-off until accepted; they never block the P0 default switch.
notes.finalBoundary: Final P0/P1 boundary is frozen once adr-widget-p0-scope.md is approved (R0); edits before approval are allowed, after approval require an ADR update.
